# There and back again: Revisiting Vannevar Bush, the linear model, and the freedom of science

...

* References (99)

## Highlights

* • This paper develops an interpretation of Bush's conception of the linear model and its relationship to the freedom of science in _Science: The Endless Frontier_ .
* • This paper details Bush's conception of the freedom of science in _The Endless Frontier_
* • This paper critically assesses the view and suggests some modifications to make Bush’s view (on my interpretation) more plausible in contemporary science funding policy.

## Abstract

Despite its age, Vannevar Bushs _Science: The Endless Frontier_ has remained a touchstone for science funding policy discussions. More specifically, many claim that Bush ushered in a new ‘social contract’ that allowed scientists to freely choose projects in accordance with their own interests while promising deliverables for the society that funds scientific institutions.
